🎥🎬: Minimum Wage (2026)

At The Slice Club, a struggling local pizzeria, a group of teenagers are doing their best to survive the chaos of working minimum-wage jobs while juggling school, friendships, relationships and everyday drama. Unfortunately, keeping the restaurant running smoothly is the last thing on most of their minds.

Led by Grace, the overwhelmed manager, the crew includes Aidan, Hyde, Julia, Luke, Ryan and Tommy, each bringing their own quirks, questionable decisions and unpredictable personalities to the workplace. Things become even more chaotic when the restaurant’s eccentric owner, Terry Sylvester, played by Randall Park, shows up and questions whether the struggling business is even worth keeping open.

Between disastrous shifts, workplace romances, ridiculous arguments and employees who seem allergic to responsibility, every day at The Slice Club becomes another hilarious disaster. With low salaries and even lower patience, surviving the job might be harder than getting paid for it.
